subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw define a new durable session process-event contract, and what authorization, redaction, replay, and compatibility guarantees must it have?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix: it creates a new core event contract and exposes intermediate run state across client/session boundaries, so automation should not choose the API shape alone.

options.title: Design core contract
options.body: Define an additive process/step event API with explicit scoping, replay, redaction, and compatibility tests before implementation.

options.title: Fold into existing streams
options.body: Extend the current item/plan/tool/session.tool model instead of adding new process.* and step.* event families.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep current progress surfaces and leave this as a future protocol design item until a consuming client proves the exact contract needed.

recommendation.title: Design core contract
recommendation.body: Define an additive process/step event API with explicit scoping, replay, redaction, and compatibility tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the closest structured execution item event surface and is the strongest available history signal for choosing whether to promote it into a durable process-event contract.
